description: Search ransomware leak-site claims for one company name or domain: has a group claimed it? Returns matching claims with group, claimed date, first-observed date, country, sector and licensed sources. Use it for a single vendor or target; use batch_exposure_check for a list of up to 25 vendor domains, and recent_claims for the newest claims overall. Every result is an unverified claim from a criminal leak site, not a confirmed breach, and found=false is not proof of absence (only commercially reusable sources are covered). Read-only, live lookup. Costs $0.01 USDC per call via x402 (payment goes in _meta["x402/payment"]); invalid input or an upstream failure returns an error and is not charged.
